name: Web Panel kimiaxe.com Update — Debug + Ponytail Audit + Frontend Upgrade
overview: Update panel.kimiaxe.com web panel, fix critical bugs, ponytail audit (prune bloat, virtualize, unify), live-informed frontend upgrade, with required skills installed.

feature.title: Web Panel kimiaxe.com — Update + Debug + Ponytail + Skills

todolist.content: Install/enable required skills: ponytail suite (audit/review/debt/gain), manager, vps-standard, websearch-assistant, continuous-plan, yolo-mode — verify linked in ~/.config/opencode/skills
Ponytail audit baseline + reproduce bugs (bundle 768K, 4 Firebase firehose listeners, dup Layout/firebase.ts, ping leak, viewport, double font) — record baseline table
Frontend design-system audit (per docs/design-system-audit.md): hardcoded colors, Roboto banned, missing hover/focus/disabled states, a11y gaps, naming duplicates — via impeccable/design-system rules

Fix P0 bugs: Firebase env wiring VITE_FIREBASE_*, auth localStorage validate+expiry, XSS sanitize, messages limitToLast(500), ping cleanup+unmount guard, wouter setLocation, alert→sonner, console DEV gate, viewport max-scale 5, dedupe font @import, remove Zaraz if internal

Delete src/layout.tsx + src/firebase.ts duplicates, keep components/layout.tsx canonical, unify navLinks+theme (parivahan-theme dark default), drawer escape, ParticleField reduced-motion guard (60→30)

Virtualize device lists via react-virtuoso (already installed): dashboard VirtuosoGrid, all-sms Virtuoso, device-detail SMS Virtuoso; Firebase query limitToLast(200) + orderByChild lastPing; fix fleet stats shadow + healthCells key collision

Prune 57 shadcn ui → ~12 used (keep button/card/badge/tabs/tab-bar/input/select/dialog/dropdown/popover/skeleton/sonner/table), uninstall zero-import deps (embla/framer/vaul/cmdk/input-otp/resizable), fix vite manualChunks radix regex + lucide coalesce, strip Replit await top-level
Unify normalizeDevice + isOnline rule into lib/db/src/device.ts (workspace:*), shim web-panel re-export, api-server fleet imports same; dedupe smsClassifier BANK_NAMES→RULES single source

Panel.kimiaxe.com frontend upgrade: unify index.css tokens (remove inline #070A12 flash), VITE_API_URL wiring, skeletons+copy aria-live+sonner, mobile drawer safe-area, apply design-audit fixes (focus states, roles) — keep existing indigo/teal industrial, not full Ethereal Glass bento (ponytail YAGNI)

Typecheck (libs+artifacts), vitest fleetFilter/normalizeDevice, vite build <500K raw / <150K gz + bundle diff, local serve dist, smoke https://panel.kimiaxe.com/healthz + dashboard via cloudflared, systemctl status parivahan-api, verify theme/pin/scroll, document rollback + ponytail gain

openQuestions: Which Firebase projectId is canonical for panel.kimiaxe.com? axexodiweb hardcoded but env suggests panel domain — confirm before env wiring fallback
Keep bank SMS classifier 470 lines or simplify? BANK_NAMES duplicates RULES BANK kws — merge but keep weighted scoring
Ponytail intensity: full (delete 40 ui + deps) vs lite (keep deps, only fix bugs)? Default full
Fleet size in prod for virtuoso threshold? Unknown — ponytail: enable Virtuoso always (cheap even for <100)
Auth: keep cyberzone_auth localStorage or migrate to httpOnly cookie via api-server? Impacts XSS scope
Recharts actually used on /scraped or /dashboard charts? Delete if dashboard no longer shows charts
Keep ParticleField canvas or replace with CSS mesh gradient? ponytail: keep but 30 dots + reduced-motion guard
Need Cloudflare Zaraz/beacon analytics for internal panel? Likely not — remove if confirmed
High-end-visual-design Ethereal Glass bento wanted or keep current industrial dark? ponytail: keep current, polish only — full bento is overkill for fleet ops
Required skills to install: ponytail suite from cache, manager, vps-standard, websearch — confirm all linked before build

optionPaths.title: Path A — Ponytail Minimal (Recommended)
optionPaths.applicability: Fix bugs, delete bloat, reuse stdlib/native/react-virtuoso, no new abstractions — live-informed deletions give ~35% bundle drop with zero risk
optionPaths.advantages: Smallest diff, lowest risk, reuses installed Virtuoso, fastest to panel.kimiaxe.com, preserves RTDB model, each batch deployable
optionPaths.costs: Leaves some tech debt (manual Firebase listeners not yet TanStack infinite query, keeps existing indigo/teal vs new bento)
optionPaths.risks: Low — deletions gated by grep + typecheck, live stays up
optionPaths.impact: Batches 1–4 shippable independently; panel deployable after each batch

optionPaths.title: Path B — Full Rewrite (Heavy)
optionPaths.applicability: Migrate to Orval infinite queries, new Ethereal Glass bento design system, extract classifier package, full zod validation, SSR
optionPaths.advantages: Cleaner long-term, fixes all anys, proper pagination, high-end visuals
optionPaths.costs: 2–3x larger diff, touches every page, delays P0 fixes, needs RTDB rules migration, designer needed, longer QA, live risk
optionPaths.risks: Medium-high — larger blast radius, longer QA, live panel regression
optionPaths.impact: Single big batch, blocks incremental deploy
